description: Words written where an element draws them (measured in Chromium 152: each shows the word): the `value` of a field with no type, of an e-mail field and of a type the browser does not know, which it makes a text field; of an image button, which shows it where it has no `alt` or `title`; of fields whose written type a binding or a second `type` overrides, `type="checkbox"` beside `[type]` and `[attr.type]` and `type="hidden"` before `type="text"`, a type the template leaves to the render being a text field until it says otherwise; and an `<iframe>`'s `srcdoc`, the document it draws. A written value speaks as a button's does, and the refusal counts eight; a read taking the first written `type` for the field's passed three of them.
